description.value: A full-service, year-round RV resort tucked in Sunshine Valley among the Cascade Mountains, 15 minutes east of Hope, with heated indoor and outdoor pools and hot tubs; geared heavily toward RVers and members, with tent camping options and pricing unclear from the site.

address.value: 14850 Alpine Blvd, Sunshine Valley, BC V0X 1L5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an operating RV resort and cabin rental located near Hope, BC, open year-round with 110 serviced RV sites and 10 cabins. The site prominently mentions online reservations, an on-site general store (food/necessities), and a propane filling station. No mention of hiker/biker sites, showers, laundry, or cyclist-specific amenities for this location. OSM has minimal tags (name and tourism=caravan_site only) with no phone or address, so contact confirmation against OSM is not possible. The membership-based model and RV focus raise questions about suitability for touring cyclists without an RV.
concerns: OSM name is 'Sunshine Valley RV Resort' but website uses 'Sunshine Valley RV Resort & Cabins'
OSM record has no phone or address to cross-check
Front page lists address as 'Sunshine Valley, BC' while contact page lists 'Hope, BC' for the same postal code
Membership-based resort model may limit accessibility for touring cyclists
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is primarily a membership-based RV resort. While cabins can be booked online, there is no evidence of tent or hiker/biker sites suitable for touring cyclists arriving without a vehicle. Needs confirmation that drop-in cyclists are welcomed and can be accommodated.
